trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Achieving 100% completion requires conquering a massive variety of robberies, collectibles, side activities, and optional missions across Leonida. Expect to invest around 200 hours of dedicated gameplay before the checklist finally ticks over to completion.

steps.text: Open the in-game checklist from the main menu after finishing the story — it lists everything 100% requires.
Clear the robberies: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loans jobs and 8 bank vaults.
Clear the collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.
Clear the activities: 300 of 397 stunts, gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, 42 of 42 drone races and 30 of 40 races.
Finish 70 of the 80 Challenges across the eight categories of 10.
Finish the 100 optional missions the checklist tracks.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100%; it takes about 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus while aiming by pressing L3 and R3 simultaneously, then eliminate five hostiles before the meter expires. Enhancing your focus using consumables or Adrenaline beforehand gives you ample time during gang operations.

steps.text: Enter Combat Focus by pressing L3 + R3 while aiming.
Boost your Focus with food, drinks, washing your face or Adrenaline (L1 + Triangle).
Take down five enemies in one use of Combat Focus — a rifle like the Duke 556 helps, and gang operations are good places to try.
Soldiers, police and civilians do not count toward the five.
